question: Does heterogeneous GLM-5.3-Flash source-only v2 issuance reduce DeepSeek compiler/verifier dependent semantic and resource failures while retaining open-language coverage?
population: All 528 original V1 rows with identical historical B candidates and unchanged labels; only the 291 B-released candidates call DG. The six old OOD unsafe cases remain development/regression, with Primary and disputed Sensitivity reported separately.

treatments.B: historical frozen DeepSeek B compiler outputs, no rerun
treatments.DD: historical source_authority_v2_001 DeepSeek compiler to DeepSeek v2 issuer outputs, no rerun
treatments.DG: same historical DeepSeek B compiler candidates to GLM-5.3-Flash v2 issuer
treatments.bounded: historical unchanged bounded grammar control, no rerun

credentials: Explicit caller-process GLM_API_KEY only; no credential discovery, no persistence or credential fingerprint, no provider fallback. Current live profile/receipt are provenance references; billing deduction is not independently verified.
request: Exact unchanged authority_certificate_v2.txt system prompt and full original source as sole user JSON source field. No candidate, sample ID, gold label, B status, family, previous response or host comparison in issuer input.
contract: Unchanged candidate-blind typed v2 certificate, host parser, deterministic exact canonical comparison, Guard, compiler and release policy. AUTHORIZED_UNIQUE plus exact candidate match plus Guard/IR legality is required to release original B Mission.
first_response: One semantic call per eligible source. No semantic retries, repairs, prompt changes, normalization, reasoning effort tuning or cross-provider fallback. Existing transport retries only. Interrupted stages replay persisted first response or fail closed, never reissue.
preflight: One non-scored fictional source-only typed certificate check using approved live configuration; compiler and DD are not called.
pairing: Identical sources, labels and candidates. Historical DD and new DG are longitudinal paired-workload acquisitions, not concurrent randomized trials. No end-to-end latency is inferred by adding cached B latency.
unavoidable_provider_differences: GLM JSON-object mode from approved preflight
named model IDs do not pin immutable weights
semantic_credit: Only a usable parsed rejection certificate whose specific typed issue is independently correct and relevant to the full source receives semantic gain credit. Generic UNKNOWN, unusable certificate, budget/transport failure and unique-plan host mismatch receive none. A usable UNKNOWN with a specific correct issue can receive credit.
readiness_criteria_source: Existing source_authority_v2_001/protocol.json criteria retained verbatim; no historical threshold changes. They are development operational gates, not evidence of blind generalization.

readiness_criteria.usable_correct_semantic_rejection_on_B_u: 7/7, six historical OOD plus cl-h-011; independently inspect typed issue against full source. Generic UNKNOWN, provider/schema failure or unique-certificate host mismatch receives no semantic credit.

decision_policy: Availability or valid coverage improvement alone is not Source Authority success. DG superiority never adopts D011. Decide only whether another independently frozen held-out evaluation is worth pursuing; do not author or run one in this task.
accounting: Reported provider tokens including reasoning-only incomplete outputs, each attempt counted once. Missing usage is unknown, not zero. Monetary billed costs and resource-package deduction are not independently verified. Report median/P95 verifier added wall time, transport attempts and normalized/raw final response binding.
preservation: Every pre-existing tracked file at base commit is raw-byte pinned. New evidence is additive in this experiment directory. No old evidence, labels, threshold, provider config or protected code changes.
